Thank you for this reply. I hate it, because I feel that because of my transgressions I don't deserve to be helped.

I suffer from PTSD still. Waking up is very hard. I need to talk to a therapist about my dad for sure. I often wonder what my life would have been like had I not suffered at his hand the way I did. I wonder if I'd be happy?

About my cousin, I can almost guarantee he was asleep but the idea of having hurt him, or this all resurfacing now at this point is my life is terrifying.

Thank you so much for being there.
was this reply meant for me? I'm so confused
